evals.prompt: Open localhost:8000 and check if there are any console errors
evals.expected_output: Opens a browser pane, navigates to localhost:8000, checks console errors and reports findings

evals.prompt: Go to https://httpbin.org/forms/post, fill in the form with some test data, and submit it
evals.expected_output: Opens browser, navigates to the form page, takes interactive snapshot, fills form fields, clicks submit, and reports the result

evals.prompt: Take a snapshot of https://news.ycombinator.com and tell me the top 3 headlines
evals.expected_output: Opens browser, navigates to HN, takes a snapshot, extracts and reports the top 3 story titles
